metadata.name: Pump Tower
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A tall concrete works stacked round an open shaft. Five floors of rooms and corridors ring the shaft, with railings, glass and open edges to drop through; a catwalk crosses it halfway up. Stairwells alternate corners, so every climb is a run round the floor. Rockets wait in a corner room midway up, body armour in the control rooms at the top, and the machinery floor at the bottom is the hill.
